description: This file defines constant index values corresponding to columns in a CSV or spreadsheet for bulk importing staff data in the Apache Fineract project. It provides a centralized location for referencing column positions when processing staff-related data.

classes.name: StaffConstants
classes.description: A utility class containing constants that represent column indices for staff data in bulk import files.
